messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Re: non-normally distributed latent trait
parts:
Why not? Already Phil says, If you can find item parameter prior distributions with empirical histogram approach or specifying the prior distributions, you can get non-normally distributed latent trait.

IRT (and so much latent variable modeling software) has the indeterminacy problem for estimating unknown parameters. So much IRT software set posterior latent distribution as N~(0,1). But, if you can know prior item parameter prior distributions, posterior latent distribution don't need to set N~(0,1) forces.

Cheers.

Seongho
